title: eupatorium rugosum var. roanense
intro: Eupatorium rugosum var. roanense, commonly known as Blue Mountain Joe Pye Weed, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the health benefits of treating fever, colds, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Mountain Joe Pye Weed include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
